title.zh: 医疗服务法 2020（保留与过渡条文）条例 2023
title.en: Healthcare Services Act 2020 (Saving and Transitional Provisions) Regulations 2023

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Healthcare Services Act 2020 (Saving and Transitional Provisions) Regulations 2023 and come into operation on 18 December 2023.

heading.en: Reference in relation to nursing homes licensed under repealed Act, etc.

text.en:
2. Any reference in any written law to —
(a)a nursing home licensed under the repealed Act; or
(b)any premises that are —
(i)licensed as a private hospital under the repealed Act; and
(ii)used or intended to be used for the reception of, and the provision of nursing for, persons suffering or convalescing from any sickness, injury or infirmity,
is to be read as a reference to any permanent premises approved under a licence deemed granted under the Act (in accordance with paragraph 1(1) of the Third Schedule to the Act) authorising the provision of a nursing home service at those approved permanent premises.

heading.en: Composition of offences under repealed Act

text.en:
3.—(1) Despite section 58 of the Act, section 20 of the repealed Act continues to apply to or in relation to any compoundable offence reasonably suspected to have been committed before 18 December 2023.
(2) In paragraph (1), “compoundable offence” means an offence prescribed as a compoundable offence under the Private Hospitals and Medical Clinics (Composition of Offences) Regulations (Rg 2) as in force immediately before 18 December 2023.
